The '''Black UnNamed''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was an [[overlord]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] and frequently patrolled the [[Red Sin Chimaera]] quadrant of the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] in his [[Rihkxyrk assault fighter]].<ref name="SWG:Es" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TempGenericPirate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of the Black UnNamed]]
The Black UnNamed appeared aboard a starship in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:Es" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Black UnNamed was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed|''Jump to Lightspeed'']] on [[October 27]], [[2004]]. The Black UnNamed was a starfighter boss that had a low probability to spawn among a group of Death Watch starfighters in the Endor system.<ref name="SWG:Es" />
